about: Phase 3 of features/statistical-abstract: what each Abstract table's source note names (`programs`, slugs in sources.json), how much of it GovGraph holds (`coverage`) and what kind of table it is (`shape`). Sections 9, 12 and 14 entered by hand; the other 27 drafted on 2026-10-14 by matching each source note against patterns (one per publication), then reviewed program by program and corrected by hand. `sections` lists the sections done, and every table in them must be here. Vocabularies and checks in server/lib/abstract-coverage.js. `unpublished`: the source note cites unpublished data, so there is nothing to collect and no program. `compiled`: the Abstract compiled the table from sources named in its footnotes, not yet traced. `in_hand`: the publisher's current file is already in the data folder, though the table's series are not loaded.
